title: avenor_peers input
description: Discriminated-union input for the avenor_peers tool: list (the default action), rename and last. Each action is one complete object with additionalProperties false, so a field belonging to another action is a schema error. The same admission rules are published as PeersApplicabilityTable in internal/messaging (Go) and assertPeersInput (TypeScript); TestSchemaMatchesRouteTable proves the schema and the table agree, and TestPeersActionVocabulary pins the action union.

action.description: List the sessions visible to the caller.

name.description: New display name, 1-64 characters with no control or formatting characters (including bidi overrides and zero-width characters, so a label cannot be rendered to look like another peer's). The schema is permissive about the byte/character distinction; the rename authority rejects a name that is too long in bytes.

session_id.description: Run to rename. Omitted renames the caller's own run for a broker caller and the supervisor session for the owner.

action.description: Read a peer's last agent message, the final text of its latest turn.

target.description: Peer: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label.
